general.timeZoneValue: America/Bogota (dates are written in Bogotá time)

emailSource.settings: The SMTP server in Settings › Email
emailSource.env: The server's MAILER_DSN (no SMTP server in Settings)
emailSource.none: Not configured: no email is sent

general.legacyOn: On: shops can still post orders to the old webhook URL.
general.legacyOff: Off: the old webhook URL answers 410 and places nothing.
general.legacyHits_one: {{count}} delivery reached it since it was turned off, the last on {{date}}.
general.legacyHits_other: {{count}} deliveries reached it since it was turned off, the last on {{date}}.
general.legacyNoHits: Nothing reached it since it was turned off.
general.turnOff: Turn off the old webhook URL
general.turnOn: Turn the old webhook URL back on
general.confirmOffTitle: Turn off the old webhook URL?
general.confirmOffBody: Shops still posting there will get 410 and their orders will not be placed. Do this after every shop points at its connection.
general.turnedOff: The old webhook URL is off.
general.turnedOn: The old webhook URL is on again.

email.smtpHint: The server the order email leaves from.
email.envNote: When empty, MAILER_DSN from the server is used.
email.envNoteHost: When empty, MAILER_DSN from the server is used ({{host}}).
email.noneNote: Nothing is configured: no email is sent until a server is saved here or MAILER_DSN is set.
email.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the current password. If you change the host, a blank password saves none.
email.passwordNew: No password is saved. A password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
email.passwordHostChanged: The host changed: a blank password saves none.
email.senderHint: Each value you leave empty falls back to the server's setting.
email.invalidPort: The port is a number from 1 to 65535.
email.hostWithPort: Enter the host name only, without a port or a scheme.

test.title: Send test email
test.intro: Sends "KF Inventory test email" through the saved server and shows the answer here.
test.failedNoReason: The server did not accept the email.
test.tooSoon: Wait a few seconds before sending another test email.

analytics.ga4Hint: G-XXXXXXX, from GA4 › Admin › Data streams.
analytics.clarityHint: The Project ID from Clarity › Settings.
analytics.status: Loads on every signed-in page for everyone; not on the sign-in page; no consent banner (internal tool). Leave a field empty to turn that tool off.
analytics.invalidGa4: A GA4 ID looks like G-ABC1234 (capital letters and digits).
analytics.invalidClarity: A Clarity ID is 6 to 20 lowercase letters and digits.
analytics.saved: Analytics settings saved. They load on the next page you open.

phrases.intro: One tap on a phrase adds it as a dated comment on an order. Inactive phrases are hidden from the comment box.
phrases.empty: No quick phrases yet. Add the first one above.
phrases.deleteBody: "{{text}}" will no longer be offered in the comment box. Comments already written keep their text.
phrases.previewEmpty: No active phrase: the comment box shows no phrase bar.
phrases.tooLong: A phrase is at most 255 characters.
